headline: Recovery week: optional 30min easy at 141bpm or lower, no intensity
summary: Nothing logged yet today. Readiness is partly in: HRV 65 (68 yesterday, down 3), but RHR and sleep have not synced, so I can't confirm green. CTL 53.9, ATL 47.4, so TSB is about +6.5 and the race load is clearing. Race on Sat 7: 22.1km, 825m D+ on the watch, 2h14 at 172bpm average (max 187), RPE 9, feel 3 (Normal), load 212. That missed the sub-2h00 target by about 14min. Mon 9 in Barcelona: 4.9km in 29min at 136bpm average, which is properly easy (Z1), RPE 2, but feel 4 (Poor). The legs are still carrying the race. Today: either rest, or run 30min easy on the flat, capped at 141bpm (Z1), with no strides. If RHR comes in at 52 or higher, or sleep under 6h, rest. Same rule for Wed 11 and Thu 12 (Barcelona, travel back Thu). No spin needed this week. The aim is to recover, not add load.
flags: The plan ends at week 8 (Sun 8 Nov). There are no sessions or planned loads after the race, so no daily edits can be made until the next block is set up in the coaching chat (pick the next race, update plan.json and current-plan.json, archive this block's sessions).
Mon run feel 4 (Poor) 2 days after an RPE 9 race: keep this week easy even if HRV looks fine.
Race review for the chat: 2h14 against a 2h00 target, with 172bpm average for 134min. Check whether the opening 20min stayed under the 165bpm cap.
